PDF 9 Multi-Dimensional Transfer Functions for Volume Rendering
This chapter provides a detailed exposition of the multidimensional transfer function concept, a generalization of multidimensional transfer functions for both scalar and multivariate data, as well as a novel technique for the inter-active generation of volumetric shadows.
